quest.title: Moonless Night
quest.description: A battle for the fate of your companions and Nod-Krai has already begun...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x875, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.num: Song of the Welkin Moon: Act VII
chapter.title: A Traveler on a Winter's Night

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A few things, actually...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Okay. Well, we'll be good to go as soon as you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nope, I'm good to go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then you'd better get going!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Very well.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: What the... Trespassers? Here? What's wrong with you people!?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: We're looking for The Doctor, and we understand he might be here. I see you're fleeing the facility...?

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: Hah... You looking to settle a score with The Doctor? Good luck with that... I don't think you'll have many chances left.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Perhaps. But you might have a chance to live — if you start talking.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: ...Two other harbingers had the same idea as you. They're already inside. But what good's it gonna do? The Doctor wouldn't do something like this unprepared...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Hmm... Seems to me that you're not too thrilled about being his subordinate.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Also, is it just me, or do I sense monsters nearby? If you'd prefer their company to ours, that can easily be arranged.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need to know what The Doctor is up to. Please, if you know anything at all, tell me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is about more than us versus The Doctor. His actions could have consequences for all of Nod-Krai — and perhaps even your homeland, Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: He's... building something — ambitious doesn't even begin to describe it. Feels like this could be the big one. God knows how long he's been planning it...

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: A while back, he told us he'd be returning to Snezhnaya. We weren't expecting him back so soon... This time, he brought some gemstones with him, or something. Two of them.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...The Moon Marrow spheres. He stole them from their rightful owner, Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: Oh... Lady Damselette? Last I heard, she left the Fatui. Before she went, she told us she'd finished what Her Majesty asked of her, and wished to focus on some personal matters.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: I remember thinking that leaving us might not be the best choice. I mean, I always looked up to The Captain the most, and...

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: Back when this all started, the higher-ups dispatched three units to Nod-Krai to execute their plan. They were led by The Doctor, Marionette, and The Damselette respectively.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: I was part of the The Damselette's unit to begin with.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: She never interacted with us much. In fact, she seemed sorta... detached from everything. Not because she was distracted, it just felt like she was indifferent to the world around her. Like she had no stake in anything that happened.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: She always seemed like she was staring off into the distance. Almost as if she didn't see anything worth living for in the present, so she had to look further afield... Ah, that's right — she always used to stare up at the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: The Doctor used to stand nearby and watch her. Apparently, they got along well at first. But somewhere along the way, she grew wary of him, and started avoiding him as much as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: After she left, everyone in our unit merged with The Doctor's. He's... similarly indifferent to the world — except when it comes to the moons. He seems to have big plans for them.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: Right now, obtaining the three moons is his number one priority. He even said... if he can only get his hands on two of them, he'll create a third one himself.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How would he create an artificial Moon Marrow? ...Maybe the knowledge he gained from the Hyperborean phantoms has something to do with it?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Thank you for cooperating. We appreciate the level of detail.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I get the sense that you'd serve under Columbina again if you had the chance. Would that be fair?

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: ...No, she's no longer a harbinger. As a member of the Fatui, my loyalty will always belong to the Tsaritsa.

dialogues.speaker: Jotautas
dialogues.text: I'm only telling you all this because I don't completely trust The Doctor. His actions do not align with the goals that first brought us to Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I understand. We'll do everything within our power to stop him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Knave's unit is based at the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. Maybe you can seek refuge with them.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Well, now we know what's going on here. Artificial Moon Marrow... he's likely well on the way to completing it. Dottore's technological capabilities are far more advanced than I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I fear this could get ugly. Everyone, prepare yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nope, I'm good to go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then you'd better get going!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Very well.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Welcome, one and all. I've been expecting you. I hope my humble research facility is to your liking.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Yeah, we really appreciated fighting our way in through a horde of monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The gall! You expect us to believe you've just been patiently waiting for us?

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Of course I have. Should I be... worried about something? Everything seems to be going quite smoothly so far — and you've shown up right on schedule.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: First Sandrone and Arlecchino, now you... Ah, quite a surfeit of guests I've had today.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: If you were looking for them, I should probably mention that Arlecchino disappeared as soon as she entered the facility.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: As for Sandrone, why, she was stood right here only moments ago, demanding answers from me at the top of her voice.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Hardly out of character — she never was one for basic courtesy. But I have to admit, I was a little surprised to see her showing concern for someone besides herself.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Does everyone you associate with undergo such a change in temperament? Speaking as a researcher, I have to say — it is not a change for the better. It threatens one's ability to remain objective.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where is Sandrone?

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Well, since you ask...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: So, you've got your hands on the Moon Marrow, and now you're claiming godhood? Don't you think that's a bit of a stretch, Dottore?

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: I must protest what you are insinuating with that phrase "claiming godhood."

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: I am not "claiming" anything — I am stating a fact. You're a researcher. I'm sure you appreciate the distinction between the two.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, you really think you're all that?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You'll excuse me if I'm not being a polite little lady for you. We're colleagues — we both know what kind of person you are.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: By the same token, I knew you'd respond along those lines.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: You and I both understand that facts speak louder than words. To that end, I've had my people send you a small gift. It should go some way towards helping you understand my present position.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: What gift?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Where have all your troops gone?

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Who knows? Perhaps they are already marching towards a new world, following in the footsteps of an unknown god...

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: As vulgar and arrogant as you may be, dear Sandrone, I have no intention of taking out my displeasure on your subordinates. They will enjoy equal rights to my own.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You sent your people to the Experimental Design Bureau!? That's the Tsaritsa's property!

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Yes, and I am very mindful of Her Majesty's instructions. But you know full well that they do not conflict with my present goals.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: In which case, all I'm doing is conducting another one of my experiments. Is there a problem with that?

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Now then. You have a judgement call to make. Am I simply lying to stall you? Or is it possible that every word I am saying is the truth — in which case, your subordinates really are in danger?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: So now you've turned on fellow Fatui soldiers? You're completely insane!

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: I set a new rule for myself: Each person gets one chance. Naturally, that includes you, Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: If you wish to leave, I won't stop you. We are colleagues, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Scumbag!

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Still, I hadn't counted on Sandrone sparing any thought for the people of this world. Shame... I always found her self-centeredness to be one of her few better qualities.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: How can she ever hope to achieve greatness when she's so obsessed with protecting her little design bureau?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: It's more than a little disingenuous to speak of achieving greatness while taking hostages. Or does honor no longer mean anything to you?

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Honor?

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: I have the marrow of two moons in my possession, and will soon complete the construction of a third. I will be the god of a new world... and you speak to me of honor? How charmingly naive.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Those are sacred relics! You do not deserve them!

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: In my view, many in this world do not deserve to be alive — and yet, I mercifully permit them to go on living, do I not?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll come to regret your actions.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: Will I now? Let's see if you can make me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A few things, actually...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Okay. Well, we'll be good to go as soon as you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Dottore is too powerful with the artificial Moon Marrow in his arsenal... Fighting him is futile.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Quickly!

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: I've always thought it is wiser to flee than surrender.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What the...!?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Forget about me! You should...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: #Where's {NICKNAME}!?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Tch...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: We've been overpowered... time to retreat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the gang's all here!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Yup. All ready. How about you two? Green and good to go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's ready!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Great. Let's get rolling, then.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Great. Well, first things first—

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Uh... Wait!

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Someone's here...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: We heard your footsteps. Although...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: #You've been here for a while now. I take it you followed {NICKNAME} — but I don't sense any ill intent in you.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Come on.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: I figured it wouldn't take you long to notice me.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: I come bearing news from my Lady, The Knave.

response.speaker: The Knave
response.text: Dottore went through the motions of returning to Snezhnaya, but it was obviously a facade. However, he has not returned to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, nor has he made an appearance in Nasha Town.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Well, in that case, he'll be in his lab way up north. Hah, I always wondered why he applied for his own private pad... He was planning this all along!

response.speaker: The Knave
response.text: Tell them that Sandrone and I will go on ahead. If they still intend to pursue this matter, they should meet us at the research center in the northern tip of Nod-Krai.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Nice of Columbina's two best friends to think of us... We appreciate the heads up. Our sincere thanks to the Fatui for your aid.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: Lady Damselette may have left our organization, but at least some of her colleagues remain genuinely concerned for her wellbeing... Not to mention that The Doctor's increasingly cryptic conduct gives us great cause for alarm.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: We have crossed swords many times before, but it's not personal — we're just on different sides. We don't lack humanity.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: And so, as fellow friends of Lady Damselette, it's only right that you should be in the know about this.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Arlecchino's situational awareness has saved us a lot of trouble.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: I'll leave the map here with you. If you do decide to head to the research center, please proceed with caution.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: And remember, at least while you're in Nod-Krai, Lady Arlecchino's subordinates are your comrades if you want them to be.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: This is very accommodating of you. We can't thank you enough.

response.speaker: Gediminas
response.text: Just doing my duty. I shall take my leave now. If you need us, you'll find us at the Experimental Design Bureau.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So The Doctor's left the Experimental Design Bureau and headed to some research center up north...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Marionette seems to think he's been planning this for a long time... But when did it start? Before he even arrived in Nod-Krai?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: It seems his loyalty to the Tsaritsa is lip service at most. Behind the scenes, he may even be working against her.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Whatever his motives, we know that he's decisive and incredibly ruthless. Facing him unprepared would be a recipe for disaster.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: At this stage, it's difficult to predict his next steps. I suggest we split into two groups. We need some people to stay behind and guard Nasha Town.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Mmm... Well, as much as I'd love to help, infiltrating research labs isn't really my area of expertise...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But at least take Cool Your Jets Ducky with you! It should be some help during the battle.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: And as for Miss Ineffa... I suppose you will stay to protect Miss Aino?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Detecting operational logic: Protect Aino. Priority: High.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Just in case, Sir Varka, I think it would be best if you stayed behind as well. You can leave the research center to us.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: I mean, I would have said the Knight of Boreas should probably be out on the front line, but... Okay, fine.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Leave Nasha Town to me. Be careful out there, okay? If things get out of hand, fall back right away.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Jahoda will be on hand to assist you. In my absence, she can handle any intel-gathering work.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: You got it, Boss. You guys make sure to get back here in one piece, alright?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: We will.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Things are moving fast. We'd better head off soon if we hope to keep pace.

choices.text: This is going to be a very dangerous mission...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it's infiltrate a secret research facility, or... Yeah, alright. Paimon'll help out here instead. Sounds like it's gonna be a pretty intense fight.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: We all have to bring our A-game here. So, anything you need to wrap up before we leave?

choices.text: Paimon, you should stay behind to help everyone here.
Okay. Can we go over the agenda again?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Haha, feeling nervous? Don't blame you. We're all a little out of our depth with this one.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Okay, so... Some time ago, Columbina was ambushed by The Doctor. It all happened pretty fast, and the last thing you saw was her vanishing into the "moon's reflection."

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Yes, though at the time, all that the rest of us saw was The Doctor using some kind of power. The next moment, Columbina had disappeared and you were falling into the sea.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: We have to get Columbina back. And whatever The Doctor's plan is in seizing the three moons' authority, we have to stop him before he succeeds.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: The Frostmoon Scions consider it our duty to rescue the Moon Goddess. I wasn't expecting so many others to come to our aid... So I want you to know that you have our utmost gratitude.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Delete)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's about time we headed over to the Curatorium of Secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We have something super important to discuss. You remember, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: All these broken machines on the ground... Someone got here before us. Could it be Arlecchino and Sandrone?
